title: Home-Style Iced Coffee
subtitle: Coffee syrup shaken frothy with a pinch of salt, ice, cold milk and a little cream.

method.label: Toddler — her glass first (no coffee)
items: Shake {@milk:toddler} in the jar until frothy and pour it into her cup — a little "milk coffee" with no caffeine

method.title: Shake the coffee
items: In the same jar or shaker, add {@syrup}, {@coffee} and {@salt}
Whisk or shake until the coffee powder dissolves and turns frothy

method.title: Serve
items: Close the jar and shake hard 20 seconds
Pour everything, ice and all, into a tall glass
Taste; add a little more syrup if you like it sweeter

method.label: Tip
method.text: The pinch of salt rounds off the bitterness — don't skip it. For the lighter iced coffee from the same card: shake 2 tbsp coffee syrup with ½ tbsp cream and ¼ cup milk, then pour over 6–7 ice cubes. No cooking: a jar with a lid or a cocktail shaker is all you need.
